info.title: PharmaSee MVP API
info.description: Draft. Pharmacy, recognition, and ledger routes require owner access and pharmacy membership where applicable. Catalog writes require owner access. Amounts use the configured currency. Dashboard dates are inclusive in the reporting time zone. Pagination and session lifecycle are pending review.
